tests.description: Sign in to the Console by injecting a chainguard-session cookie instead of logging in

steps.description: Open a static Console URL so the browser is on chainguard.dev before setting the cookie. The favicon avoids the SPA's redirect to /auth/login
Set the session cookie the issuer would normally set after login
Open the Console with the session in place
Give the SPA time to check the session and redirect if it rejects it
Capture what the Console rendered, for diagnosis
Pass only if the Console didn't send the browser back to the login page
